headline: Approved $27,816.45 roof design contract for Bicentennial Elementary and $10,000.00 invoice for Main Dunstable Elementary work
summary: The Joint Special School Building Committee approved a design contract with ARM for the Bicentennial Elementary roof replacement and approved a $10,000.00 invoice from EEI for completed work at Main Dunstable Elementary. The committee also accepted the July 23, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Accepted the July 23, 2026 JSSBC meeting minutes and placed them on file.
Accepted the bid from ARM for roof design work at Bicentennial School, not to exceed $27,816.45.
Approved the $10,000.00 invoice from EEI for completed work at Main Dunstable.

decision_evidence.quote: Alderman Dowd moved to waive the reading of the JSSBC meeting minutes of July 23, 2026, accept them and place them on file. Approved
Alderman Sennott moved to accept the bid from ARM to do the design work for the roof at Bicentennial School in an amount not to exceed $27,816.45. So voted unanimously.
Ms. Bishop moved to approve the invoice from EEI for $10,000.00 for the completed work at Main Dunstable. So voted unanimously.

plain_text:

JOINT SPECIAL SCHOOL BUILDING COMMITTEE MEETING 
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 14, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A meeting of the Joint Special Building Committee was held at Nashua High School North on Monday, 
September 14, 2026. Alderman Dowd called the meeting to order at 5:45 p.m. 
 
Present: Mr. Dowd, Mr. Sennott, Mr. Ravan, Ms. Raymond, Ms. Bishop, Mr. Johnson, Ms. Lopez, and 
Ms. Prinn 
 
Also Present: Mr. Shawn Smith, Dr. Andrade 
 
Also Present: Members of the Public, Channel 22 Videographer 
 
 
PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES APPROVAL – July 23, 2026 
 
Alderman Dowd moved to waive the reading of the JSSBC meeting minutes of July 23, 2026, 
accept them and place them on file.  Approved 
 
 
REMARKS BY CHAIRMAN – Alderman Dowd 
Two items to cover this evening. 
 
REMARKS BY ADMINISTRATION – Mr. Smith 
No remarks. 
 
Bicentennial Roof Replacement 
• Mr. Smith presented five qualified proposals for the roof design contract at Bicentennial 
Elementary. 
• The committee discussed the range of bids, from $27,816.45 to $134,700.00. 
Alderman Sennott moved to accept the bid from ARM to do the design work for the roof at 
Bicentennial School in an amount not to exceed $27,816.45.  So voted unanimously.   
 
INVOICE APPROVAL 
 
 Invoice Approval – View Invoices  
 
a. EEI, Total $10,000.00  
i. Application #16B, $10,000.00 – Main Dunstable Elementary  
 
Birch Hill/Main Dunstable: $10,000.00  
Total Invoices: $10,000.00 
 
Ms. Bishop moved to approve the invoice from EEI for $10,000.00 for the completed work at Main 
Dunstable.  So voted unanimously.   
 
Alderman Sennott moved to adjourn. Motion passes 8-0 at 5:50 pm. 
 
Submitted by Tara C. Kinsella
